notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
[p]Thanks for playing my game on Steam Demo Fest and filling out the form or making a video.
I'm glad most people liked it. It really helps with development. ❤️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/1d819b6eb8762bb2fee067e177ebd20c022e8bcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Update changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Door colliders are turned off during opening, so as not to push the player[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "pile" at the start so that it does not seem that the player is too tall[/p][/*][*][p]The scene in the elevator has been reconfigured so as not to warn in advance[/p][/*][*][p]The red TV timings have been reconfigured and changed sound[/p][/*][*][p]Added a turn of the player in the right direction to the scene in the elevator and the tumbler outside the window, it does not block the controls, but will help not to miss important things[/p][/*][*][p]You can now spin the disk on the floor while standing and spin on it if you stand on it[/p][/*][*][p]The Kamaz now makes noise only if you lift the photo[/p][/*][*][p]If you look closely, you can see a bear at the start of the demo[/p][/*][*][p]The refrigerator is not so empty where the hint is[/p][/*][*][p]The statue of a wooden gnome, fixed the rotation pivot[/p][/*][*][p]Matches now burn a few seconds longer[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the music in the credits and just inserted my guitar[/p][/*][*][p]There is now soda on the shelf. And from the top right one 4 packs fall out[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The demo is just a small part of the game. I'm off to make the full version 🙂[/p][p]To not miss the game's release, join the discord [url="https://discord.gg/mPF4R5TjVg"]https://discord.gg/mPF4R5TjVg[/url] and add it to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/e299dc19a409d398bd3c45965107fe0a585b194c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play the demo!🔥
notes.content: [h1]New demo available![/h1][p]The demo contains only part of the game, one apartment - your task is to find the exit and get out.[/p][p]The walkthrough will take 10-20 minutes. There is a variety of scares and 2 achievements - one for the walkthrough and a secret one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/5a550f27e76d4927f89bcaa06de04d08f1ac0e63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678230/MATRESHKA_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Thank you for your feedback ❤️[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/956f4ee9a3f7d414d327eeb1874ac1ef43c511b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046469/60b3d96f882c3a1beb1005f6ae3562b534927c6b.jpg"][/img][/p]
